content.text:
I've added the `/partners` gate to [I:/Scratch/_trimtest/T4-B-1/proxy.ts](proxy.ts). Nothing is committed.

**What it does:** any request under `/partners` now needs a valid client session cookie (`sol_client`), the same one the `/client` portal uses. That cookie is only given out after the per-client password check in `lib/client-auth.ts`, so the password check is the same too. A visitor without that cookie is sent to `/client/login`.

**What I checked:** the type-check shows no errors in `proxy.ts`. I didn't start a dev server or test the redirect in a browser.

**Three things that might not match what you meant:**
1. **There's no `/partners` page.** Nothing exists under `app/partners/`. A signed-in client who gets past the gate will see a 404 until someone builds the page.
2. **Any signed-in client can open it.** `/partners` has no workspace in its URL, so I didn't add a per-workspace check. If only some clients or partners should see it, the gate needs an allowlist.
3. **After signing in, users go to their workspace, not `/partners`.** The login page has no way to send someone back to the page they started on. They'd have to open `/partners` again by hand.
